invariant: CommandLinkClass resolves the exact supplied relationship endpoint through the existing quark tree before creating a missing class leaf, and an existing group remains the endpoint entity whether it is empty or contains children. A bare quoted package name with spaces is therefore looked up as that same quoted display identity rather than normalized into an underscore identifier. SVEK converts a directly empty group into its package leaf while preserving the group UID. For a filled group, Bibliotekon#getNodeUid selects Cluster#getSpecialPointId and ClusterDotString emits that point inside the cluster before routing the edge. SVG endpoint metadata uses the group's own short quark name rather than its fully qualified nesting path.
causal_divergence: The renderer now correctly maps ordinary existing groups to empty-package leaves or filled-cluster special points and clips filled-group splines at the painted boundary. However, ClassParser::try_relationship applies strip_creole_for_id to every quoted endpoint before quark lookup, replacing spaces with underscores. ClassParser::try_package stores a bare quoted package under its original display string, so a relationship naming that display misses the group and creates a synthetic class. Seven non-quoted follow-up matrices pass while both quoted group controls fail at this parser boundary.
planned_change: Preserve the raw contents of a quoted relationship endpoint for existing-quark resolution, while retaining the current normalized identifier fallback for genuinely missing quoted class endpoints. Then route the resolved group through the existing leaf-or-cluster endpoint model, package UID mapping, short-name metadata, and DotPath.simulateCompound clipping.
